clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Ashenvale, Fallen Sky Lake lies between Silverwing Outpost and the Warsong Labor Camp. Shadethickets defend its shores and central isle.

Fallen Sky Lake lies south of Silverwing Outpost and west of the Warsong Labor Camp. Shadethickets, hulking bog beasts, roam its shores and the small isle at its center, treating intruders as threats. A powerful Shadethicket Oracle rules from the isle's heart. The Oracle hoards the fallen moonstones once gathered at the lake and keeps the shadethickets bound to the waters, ever watchful for travelers.
